name: AEX image probe request schema

request.plugin_path: absolute path to .aex; required for describe/render_png
request.allowlist: path to allowlist JSON; required for describe/render_png
request.input_png: path to input PNG; required for render_png and identity_transport
request.output_png: path to output PNG; required for render_png and identity_transport
request.params: object keyed by stable parameter id
request.worker_exe: absolute path to the reviewed cargo example stub or a dynamic test stub under target/aex-image-probe/test-workers; required after allowlist validation when worker launch is enabled
request.loader_preflight: path to AEX loader preflight report JSON; required when loader_intent.request_real_aex_load is true, must have status preflight_passed_no_load, must still report native_load_performed=false and broker_may_load_plugin=false, and must include matching selected_candidate plus selected_loader_entry identity evidence for the allowlist id and requested plugin_path

loader_intent.request_real_aex_load: boolean; true only for contract tests that exercise the fail-closed loader gate
loader_intent.sandbox_profile: declared requested sandbox profile; windows-job-object-v0 | unknown | missing; not measured evidence and not loader approval

entries.expected_class: classic-effect | classic-effect-candidate | aegp | aeio | smartfx-only | gpu-only | unknown
entries.sandbox_profile_status: allowlist policy declaration; implemented-v0 | missing | unknown; not measured sandbox status

response.plugin_class: classic-effect | aegp | aeio | smartfx | identity-transport | unknown
response.stage: null or handshake | load | global_setup | params_setup | sequence_setup | render | sequence_teardown | global_teardown

loader_approval.requested: boolean; true when loader_intent.request_real_aex_load is true
loader_approval.approved: boolean; always false in current contract slice
loader_approval.loader_enabled: boolean; always false in current contract slice
loader_approval.real_aex_load_enabled: boolean; always false in current contract slice
loader_approval.approval_status: string from request loader_intent or missing
loader_approval.allowlist_approval_status: string from allowlist entry or missing
loader_approval.sandbox_profile: string from request loader_intent or missing
loader_approval.sandbox_profile_status: string from allowlist entry or missing
loader_approval.worker_revalidation: string from request loader_intent or missing
loader_approval.worker_revalidation_status: string from allowlist entry or missing
loader_approval.job_object: boolean checklist item; mirrors sandbox_preflight.job_object_assigned when preflight is present
loader_approval.handle_inheritance_disabled: boolean checklist item; mirrors sandbox_preflight.handle_inheritance_disabled when preflight is present; sentinel measurement is not a full handle-table audit
loader_approval.environment_sanitized: boolean checklist item; true for current env_clear worker launch
loader_approval.controlled_working_directory: boolean checklist item; mirrors sandbox_preflight.controlled_working_directory when preflight is present
loader_approval.bounded_stdio: boolean checklist item; true for bounded captured previews
loader_approval.worker_side_revalidation: boolean; false until worker confirms its own allowlist identity recheck

sandbox_preflight.job_object_status: assigned | unsupported_platform | create_failed | set_limit_failed | assign_failed | not_attempted
sandbox_preflight.checks: array of { name, status: measured_pass | measured_fail | not_measured | not_applicable, evidence, denied_reason }

worker_attestation.handle_inheritance_disabled: boolean; true only when a provided inheritable sentinel is not visible in the worker

sandbox_preflight.handle_inheritance_status: not_measured | not_applicable | sentinel_created | sentinel_not_inherited | sentinel_inherited | sentinel_unverified | sentinel_missing | sentinel_create_failed

response.output_png: path to output PNG when identity_transport succeeds or a future render succeeds
response.crash: null or crash summary without binary payload

notes: Broker process must not load .aex.

Broker may spawn only an explicit reviewed worker_exe path: the cargo example aex_effect_worker_stub under the crate target tree or a dynamic test stub under target/aex-image-probe/test-workers with an allowed mode, current process id, and numeric stamp; no shell or PATH worker discovery.
On Windows, worker launch uses an explicit inherited-handle list for bounded stdio and excludes the handle-inheritance sentinel from that list.
Worker-launch preflight records file metadata but does not hash private binaries by default.

For render_png with worker_exe, broker decodes PNG, validates dimensions/decoded byte limits, writes raw RGBA only under target/aex-image-probe, and creates a worker transport manifest containing schema_version, transport_protocol_version, pixel_format, width, height, row_stride_bytes, decoded_bytes, raw_rgba_path, and generated_root.

For identity_transport, broker decodes a synthetic PNG, validates dimensions/decoded byte limits, and writes a create-new RGBA8 PNG under target/aex-image-probe without requiring plugin_path, allowlist, worker_exe, loader_preflight, or loader_intent.
identity_transport status ok is a broker pixel-transport check only; it is not .aex rendering, parameter description, worker execution, loader approval, or output correctness evidence.
The worker stub validates the transport manifest and raw file only; the manifest must not contain .aex paths.
Failed worker/preflight reports keep output_png null; raw RGBA transport is not a rendered output.
Worker process must re-check allowlist before any future native module load.
loader_intent is not an approval mechanism; it only asks the current contract to prove that the loader gate fails closed.

When loader_intent.request_real_aex_load is true, the broker requires a separate loader_preflight report before worker identity revalidation can run; missing, blocked, mismatched, or payload-bearing preflight evidence fails closed before worker launch.

The loader_preflight receipt must bind selected_candidate.loader_gate_effect_id and selected_loader_entry.effect_id to the allowlist entry id; selected_loader_entry.plugin_path and selected_loader_entry.normalized_plugin_path must be path-consistent with the request plugin_path and allowlist plugin_path, with path_match_status=matched_normalized_path and entry_ready=true.
Current loader_approval reports must keep approved=false, loader_enabled=false, and real_aex_load_enabled=false.
Worker identity revalidation may pass while approved=false, loader_enabled=false, real_aex_load_enabled=false, and output_png is null.

When a real-load intent reaches the worker boundary, the broker writes a generated-root worker-loader-ticket JSON and the worker validates it as accepted_no_load; this ticket is still not loader approval and must keep native_load_performed=false and worker_may_load_plugin=false.
Worker identity revalidation uses a separate generated worker-identity manifest; the pixel transport manifest must remain free of .aex identity fields.
Sandbox preflight is measured runtime evidence only. It does not approve native loading by itself.

Handle inheritance is measured with a Windows-only inheritable sentinel. The Windows worker launcher uses an explicit inherited-handle list; sentinel_inherited is a hard fail, while sentinel_not_inherited is prerequisite evidence but not a full handle-table enumeration.

loader_approval.approved may become true only in a separately opened loader slice after approval metadata, identity revalidation, sandbox_preflight.status=passed, and handle inheritance policy are all accepted.
A passed sandbox_preflight must not change loader_enabled or real_aex_load_enabled while the current no-load contract remains active.
PNG is broker-facing v0 format; worker may receive raw RGBA temp file or shared memory.
No ICC/color-management fidelity is claimed in v0.
No binary payloads, hashes, or private assets are embedded in reports.
